title: TerminationArtifact
description: Persisted record explaining why a session ended without `synthesis` (§2.6, §4.8, R2). A session ends with exactly one of: a `synthesis` message in the canonical_transcript, OR a TerminationArtifact persisted alongside it. The reason enum is extended from the §8 skeleton with `user_input_required` and `external_research_required` (§4.4, §4.7).

schema_version.description: SemVer of the schema this artifact validates against (§5.1). Pass 4 schemas are `1.0.0`.

reason.description: Why the session terminated. CLOSED enum (§4.7).

final_round.description: Highest round number reached before termination. 0 if termination occurred during `init` or `selector` phases.

cumulative_usage.description: Aggregated token/cost usage across every provider invocation in the session.

most_recent_verdict.description: The verdict from the last completed coordination_turn before termination, if any. Null if termination occurred before any round closed.

unresolved_disagreements.description: Cumulative unresolved disagreements collected up to the termination point. Same shape as Verdict.unresolved_disagreements.

transcript_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest (lowercase, 64 chars) computed over the JCS-canonicalized canonical_transcript at termination (§7.7). Tightened by Pass 6 from the Pass 4 permissive `minLength: 1`; pre-publication finalization, no version bump. MUST equal `Artifact.transcript_digest` when both are present (terminate paths).

pending_user_input_request.description: Present only when `reason = user_input_required` (§4.4). Copy of the verdict's `user_input_request` payload so downstream consumers can resume in a v1 interactive mode.

pending_external_research_request.description: Present only when `reason = external_research_required` (§4.4). Copy of the verdict's `external_research_request` payload.

last_provider_failure.description: Diagnostic snapshot of the last provider error before retries were exhausted; populated when `reason` is provider-attributable (`provider_unrecoverable` / `schema_error`). Carries enough context for an operator to reproduce the failed spawn — `agent_id` + `provider` + `model` identify the routing; `kind` + `message` + `details` forward the upstream's actual complaint (eg. "unknown variant `max`, expected one of `none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh`" for a codex CLI version mismatch). Optional + additive: artifacts produced by 1.10.6 and earlier omit this field. Added v1.10.7 / Codex review T1 item #2.

kind.description: Mirrors §6.6 ErrorKind enum. The `error` field in provider_result is a `oneOf` of [null, object]; the kind enum lives inside the object branch at `oneOf/1/properties/kind` (Codex review T3 fix — the earlier `properties/error/properties/kind` pointer didn't resolve because `error` has no direct `properties`, it has `oneOf`).
